parts.text: A full name was split into first and last name columns: repaired with set_join_source; 6/6 validation checks passed; contract gate passed.
Latitude and longitude were combined into coordinates: repaired with set_split_source; 8/8 validation checks passed; contract gate passed.
The publisher removed the required stable identifier: escalated with escalate; 3/6 validation checks passed; contract gate failed because no identifier can be fabricated safely.
The source began publishing duplicate identifiers: escalated with escalate; 5/6 validation checks passed; contract gate failed because no evidence identifies the authoritative duplicate row.
